title: verbascum suworowianum var. papillosum
intro: Verbascum suworowianum var. papillosum, commonly known as the Chinese Mullein or Woolly Mullein, is a plant species that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. The health benefits of Verbascum suworowianum var. papillosum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable medicinal plant in traditional Chinese medicine.
